title: 15th Meeting of the Corporate Services Committee

content.string: The meeting is called to order at 12:00 PM.
That it BE NOTED that no pecuniary interests were disclosed.

1.title: Council Policy Review - Flags at City Hall and Illumination of City of London Buildings and Amenities

motion_texts.string: That the proposed Illumination of City of London Buildings and Amenities Policy BE AMENDED by adding the remainder of the month of June to be allocated for national Pride month, with part j), as amended to read as follows:
“j)    Notwithstanding the above, City of London buildings and amenities with multi-colour capable LED lighting installations shall be illuminated on the following occasions:

i)    June 6: purple and green for Our London Family

ii)    the remainder of June: rainbow for national Pride month (noting that individual lighting requests will also be accommodated)

iii)    July 1: red and white for Canada Day

iv)    September 30: orange for National Day for Truth and Reconciliation (National Orange Shirt Day)

v)    November 10 and 11: red for Remembrance Day

vi)    the remainder of November: purple for Shine the Light on Woman Abuse

vii)    December: red and green for the holidays”
